summary: This is an MMDetection configuration file (no callable functions/classes). It defines a Cascade Mask R-CNN model with ResNet-50 + FPN backbone trained on COCO for 12 epochs (1x schedule). It inherits from 4 base configs: model architecture, dataset, training schedule, and runtime defaults.
note: This file contains only configuration dictionaries — no functions, classes, or callable APIs. Examples below describe how the config is used via MMDetection CLI tools.

examples.run_cascade_mask_rcnn_training: run cascade mask rcnn training on coco dataset using mmdet train command with this config
examples.run_cascade_mask_rcnn_inference: run inference with the cascade mask rcnn model on images using mmdet test command
examples.review_cascade_rcnn_config: review the cascade mask rcnn config to understand the 3-stage roi head and fcn mask head settings
examples.summarize_cascade_rcnn_architecture: summarize the cascade rcnn architecture with resnet50 backbone fpn neck and 80 class outputs
examples.build_custom_cascade_rcnn_config: build a custom cascade rcnn config by overriding base config values like num classes or lr
